english.title: Break up or open street part under control or management of railway undertakers or navigation authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a relevant undertaker, broke up or opened a street at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) where the street, not being a highway maintainable at public expense,

(A)_[was under the control or management of, or was maintainable by railway undertakers,]_
(B)_[was under the control or management of, or was maintainable by a navigation authority,]_
(C)_[formed part of a level crossing belonging to another person,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY UNDERTAKERS, AUTHORITY OR PERSON), without

(D)_[its]_
(E)_[her]_
(F)_[his]_

consent
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 3(5) of Schedule 13 to the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a relevant undertaker,
without the consent of the undertakers or authority or of the person to whom the level crossing belonged,
broke up or opened a street
where the street, not being a highway maintainable at public expense,
was under the control or management of, or was maintainable by railway undertakers or a navigation authority OR
formed part of a level crossing belonging to such an undertaker or to such an authority or to any other person
